entries.subject: DAMIT 14541: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: DAMIT model 14541, version 2022-11-29, pole (84°, 34°), period 23.463 h, taken unchanged from the archive. Mirror solution 14542 recorded as an alternative.

entries.subject: Physical scale
entries.finding: 124.125 ± 1.263 km, effective diameter of a sphere fitted to thermal infrared measurements. JPL lists a diameter of 124.125 ± 1.263 km, from NEOWISE (Masiero et al. 2012, ApJ 759, L8; PDS bundle neowise_diameters_albedos 2.0). The thermal sphere diameter is transferred to the mesh as its volume-equivalent diameter.

entries.subject: PDS SBN catalogue values that disagree with the factsheet or are not shown
entries.finding: Shown rotation "23.463 hours" (damit-models) differs from the LCDB V4.0 summary record 712 period 11.7426 h (U 3, synodic); the shown value is kept.

entries.subject: Boliviana whole-disc color
entries.finding: Gaia Collaboration, Galluccio et al. (2023) published the mean of 21 Gaia epoch spectra of the unresolved disc: reflectance against the Sun in 16 bands from 374 to 1034 nm, 1 at 550 nm (0.928 at 462 nm, 1.017 at 638 nm). The shape is painted in that one color (#383835 in sRGB) through the shared disc-integrated-color method, scaled to the 3.9% geometric albedo JPL lists (± 0.5%), from NEOWISE (Masiero et al. 2011, ApJ 741, 68; PDS bundle neowise_diameters_albedos 2.0). It is one mean, not a map. Tinaut-Ruano et al. (2023), A&A 669, L14, found Gaia DR3 reflectances slightly too red at wavelengths shorter than 550 nm; the bands are used as published, without that paper's correction.
